name: FineDehalo
description: Reduces dark and bright halos around high-contrast edges. Best for anime and DVD upscales. Powered by vs-jetpack.

params.label: Horizontal radius
params.help: Halo width in pixels. Set as low as possible — the docs note that values too high will start missing small halos.

params.label: Dark halo strength
params.help: 0 by default — affecting dark halos often does more damage than people want.

params.label: Edge threshold (min)
params.help: Minimum sharp-edge threshold. Below this, edges are not considered for dehalo.

params.label: Sensitivity (low)
params.help: Below this sensitivity, dehalo is fully applied.

params.label: Sensitivity (high)
params.help: Above this sensitivity, dehalo is fully skipped.

params.label: Supersampling
params.help: Internal supersampling factor to reduce aliasing. Higher = better quality, slower.

params.label: Contra-sharpening
params.help: Restore some edge contrast lost to dehalo. 0 disables.
